summary: Make the extension runtime consumable: the EXTRUNTIME_* configuration section (extruntimeconfig, disabled by default), the pkg/extruntime/wiring component that cmd/server and cmd/worker compose from it (Node pool, @iota-uz/sdk dist verification, host manifest, configurator, MCP tools, public-endpoint tenant by configured ID or Host header), a server-composition smoke test, and the consumer guide docs/extensions/consumer.md.
